process-of-elimination-tracker.note: The inherited article contained fabricated decision-time and satisfaction statistics, invented first-party observations, and arbitrary numeric rules presented as if generally validated. The effective public record is narrowed to a low-stakes decision workflow: state real constraints, eliminate only clear failures, separate unknowns from failures, compare survivors, and use a reversible information-gaining step when uncertainty remains.

plan-tasks-by-peak-energy.note: The inherited article mixed unsupported chronobiology effect sizes with fabricated productivity observations, caffeine and nutrition prescriptions, health-adjacent advice, and rigid timing claims. The effective public record is rewritten as a self-observation and scheduling experiment: observe normal workdays, find a tentative personal window, move one demanding task, and keep the scheduling rule only when the user's own work results and coordination costs justify it.

oblique-strategies-prompt-cards.note: The inherited article contained fabricated internal pilots, completion-rate and idea-count effects, pseudo-optimal deck sizes and timers, and overclaimed mechanisms for creativity. The effective public record is narrowed to a reversible prompt-constraint exercise: name the stuck artifact, introduce one safe constraint, create a separate variant, and keep only changes that improve the actual brief.

phase-transition-ritual-tracker.note: The inherited article presented a physics analogy as a behavioral mechanism and included fabricated field trials, self-report effects, arbitrary optimized durations, and health-adjacent breathing or mobility prescriptions. The effective public record is rewritten as a context-handoff checklist: preserve the unfinished state, make one visible closing move, name the first action of the next mode, and keep the handoff only when it reduces practical switching friction.
